capabilities.name: Precise part from text or sketch
capabilities.why: Describe a part with dimensions and get a correct solid.

capabilities.name: Editable feature tree
capabilities.why: Change a dimension later and the model updates, like Creo's model tree.

capabilities.name: Assemblies with constraints
capabilities.why: Place parts with mates and keep them positioned when parts change.

capabilities.name: 2D production drawings
capabilities.why: Views, dimensions and annotations a workshop can build from, as DWG, DXF or PDF.

capabilities.name: Work on existing CAD
capabilities.why: Open and change your old STEP, native or scanned parts, not only start from scratch.

capabilities.name: Consistent results
capabilities.why: The same request gives the same correct part every time. Measured in our benchmark.

candidates.name: Zoo (Design Studio + Zookeeper)
candidates.summary: The most complete AI-first CAD today: text to parametric B-rep parts written as KCL code, with a feature tree you can edit.

tree.note: Full feature tree and editable parameters

assembly.note: Assemblies shipped; reliable mates still in progress for Q4 2026

existing.note: Converts Creo, NX and SolidWorks files for enterprise pilots; STEP to editable model in progress

candidates.name: Backflip AI
candidates.summary: Turns scans and STL meshes into parametric CAD with a feature tree. Strong on existing parts, not a design tool from scratch.

create.note: Starts from a mesh or scan, not a description

existing.note: Scans and STLs to editable CAD, Fusion and SOLIDWORKS plugins

candidates.name: Autodesk Fusion AI
candidates.summary: AI features inside a full parametric CAD system. Already automates drawings; text to CAD is useful for concepts.

drawings.note: Automatic views, dimensions, annotations and BOM from the 3D model

candidates.name: Adam
candidates.summary: Text to 3D with part editing and parameters. Fast for concepts and prototypes.

candidates.name: DraftAid
candidates.summary: Does one job: production drawings from existing 3D models, with your company templates, exported as DWG, DXF, IDW or PDF. The drawing piece of the puzzle.

drawings.note: Batch 2D drawings from 3D, DWG, DXF or PDF

existing.note: Works on your existing 3D models, for drawings only

candidates.name: Luxxo CAD
candidates.summary: Text and sketch to 3D CAD, free on the web and Android. Made by Braytron's publisher and scored by the same rules.

incumbents.name: PTC Creo
incumbents.text: Creo 13, released in June 2026, added the Creo AI Assistant: a chat inside Creo that gives best-practice guidance and troubleshooting. A beta reads the open 3D model to flag design issues and check compliance. It helps you use Creo; it does not model for you yet.

incumbents.name: Autodesk AutoCAD
incumbents.text: Autodesk Assistant in AutoCAD answers questions, checks drawings against CAD standards and reads drawing context. Markup Assist can carry out simple commands such as move, copy and delete from PDF markups. Drafting itself is still manual.

changes.text: Tracker launched with six contenders. Zoo leads with 6 of 12 points; no tool covers all six capabilities.
